title: Pim Lammers: Childrens Book Writer Allegations Dropped
text:
After facing unfounded accusations, children’s book author Pim Lammers has reached a settlement with Civitas Christiana . Learn the details of the agreement, including what actions Civitas Christiana is required to take, and how this resolution allows Pim Lammers to focus on his upcoming work. This article provides a comprehensive overview of the legal battle and its positive outcome for Pim Lammers.
Civitas Christiana Agrees to Cease Accusations Against Author Pim Lammers Published: April 16, 2025
Settlement Reached: A Chapter Closed The ultra-conservative catholic Foundation Civitas Christiana has agreed to delete all messages concerning children’s book author Pim Lammers and will refrain from repeating accusations against him. This agreement follows summary proceedings initiated last week, with Singel publishers.
Pim Lammers at the Book Ball in 2024. (ANP) The dispute arose from repeated actions by Civitas Christiana targeting Lammers. Leading up to the Week of the spring jitters, the foundation made what the publisher describes as unfounded accusations of pedophilia against lammers.
Publisher’s Response and Legal Action Singel publishers, based in Amsterdam, along with Lammers, took action at the end of last month due to what they characterized as “multiple hate campaigns” and the “spread of fake news” by Civitas Christiana.
We do not accept that lying and dangerous disinformation about an author of us will be distributed.
Singel publishers
The publishing house initially demanded that the foundation remove all falsehoods about Lammers. When Civitas Christiana failed to comply, summary proceedings were initiated.
Statements and Future Plans Director Paulien Loerts of Singel publishers expressed satisfaction with the outcome:
Now that Civitas Christiana has met all our requirements and we have made good agreements for the future, we are of course very satisfied with this outcome.
Paulien Loerts, Director, Singel Publishers
Lammers also shared his relief and future plans:
I am glad that this chapter is finally closed, I will now fully focus on my next book.
Pim Lammers, author
His next project will be a collection of poems centered on the theme of love. Lammers reflected that the experiences of the past two years have reinforced his belief that this world can use a little more love.
Background: Previous Incidents 2023: Lammers,31,withdrew as writer of the children’s book poem following death threats. Civitas Christiana initiated a petition calling for Lammers’ removal and brought an old story by the author to public attention. Accusations: The foundation’s actions included accusations that prompted the publisher and author to take legal steps to protect Lammers’ reputation and ensure accurate information is disseminated.
